posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked: A lot of good celebrities have died recently, but none have really hit me. I loved Robin Williams and Leonard Nimoy, but their deaths did not hit me. This one does. Terry Pratchett was a wonderful writer, and one of the very few that could use comedy to tell dramatic stories that criticized the world we lived in and inspire people to do better. He will be missed, but he leaves a legacy that will endure.
